draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.63, the 235th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 20th of 22 at LB. He went 153rd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (235th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing concerns: 20-yard shuttle (4th percentile), broad jump (4th percentile). College production: 88 tackles in 2020, 7th of 22 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Chicago Bears (reserve). 45 career games and 10 starts over 4 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 0 AV in 2024 against a career-best 4 in 2022. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (0th percentile). Played 1 of 17 games in 2024. Versus the typical Year-4 off-ball linebacker who played: 2 combined tackles against a median of 40, below the norm.
